cases.title: Verify both Classic and Modern themes exist under theme preferences
cases.description: Navigate to the theme preferences section and verify that both the Classic and Modern themes are present and listed.

cases.title: Verify theme preferences existence under corrupted configuration state
cases.description: Attempt to access theme preferences when configuration files are missing to ensure system behavior handles missing Classic or Modern themes gracefully.

cases.title: Verify Classic theme display layout
cases.description: Navigate to theme preferences and select the Classic theme to verify that its basic visual elements and layout render without errors.

cases.title: Verify Modern Theme Presence in Configuration
cases.description: Verify that the Modern theme configuration data is present and loaded properly for theme rendering.

cases.title: Verify Theme Preferences item exists under View menu
cases.description: Open the View menu and verify that the 'Theme Preferences' item is present and available for selection.

cases.title: Verify View menu rendering without theme items under abnormal state
cases.description: Inspect the View menu when theme items fail to load and verify that the 'Theme Preferences' item is correctly handled or omitted.

cases.title: Verify Get New Themes under View Menu
cases.description: Open the View menu and verify that the 'Get New Themes' item is available.

cases.title: Verify Classic item under View menu
cases.description: Open the View menu and verify that the 'Classic' item is available and correctly listed.

cases.title: Verify Modern item availability under View menu
cases.description: Open the View menu and verify that the 'Modern' item is present and available.

opinions.feedback: The proposed cases generally cover the requirements, but some cases introduce vague or unsupported negative scenarios like corrupted configuration states that are not defined in the requirements. Please revise the test cases to focus strictly on the explicit requirements for theme preferences and View menu items without assuming unstated error-handling conditions.
confirmed_blockers: Case G-002 tests an unsupported corrupted configuration state not defined by requirement R-175.
Case G-006 tests an abnormal state where theme items fail to load, which is not supported by requirement R-178.

analysis.analysis: For R-175: Normal scenario is navigating to theme preferences to verify both Classic and Modern themes exist. Abnormal scenario is verifying behavior when theme definitions are missing or corrupted. For R-176: Blocker identified as the given image is missing, making visual display verification untestable as specified. For R-177: Blocker identified as the given image is missing, making visual display verification untestable as specified. For R-178: Normal scenario is verifying that the 'Theme Preferences' item is available under the View menu. Abnormal scenario is verifying behavior when the View menu is rendered without theme items. For R-179: Normal scenario is verifying that the 'Get New Themes' item is available under the View menu. For R-180: Normal scenario is verifying that the 'Classic' item is available under the View menu. For R-181: Normal scenario is verifying that the 'Modern' item is available under the View menu.
